description_expanded: Overview5.0(10 reviews)Newly Renovated- MH and CH - 6 Free Bikes - Community Lagoon Pool - Private Beach- 'Hello Sunshine'The Space Hello Sunshine – Newly Renovated Home & Carriage House in Seacrest Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Access to 12,000 Sq. Ft. Lagoon Pool – One of the largest pools on 30A! 6 Adult Bikes Included – Explore Seacrest, Rosemary & Alys Beach with ease Prime Location – Biking distance to shops, restaurants & the beach Seacrest Beach Tram Service (March - October) – Convenient & hassle-free beach access Spacious Open-Concept Living & Dining – Light, airy & perfect for family gatherings Multiple Bedrooms & Loft Space – Plenty of room for kids & adults alike Private Carriage House with Full Kitchen & Living Room – Ideal for extra privacy & comfort Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Convenient & hassle-free Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to Hello Sunshine------Newly Renovated -----Hello Sunshine will be your go to place for vacation memories every year. This home and carriage home is filled with all of your needs for the perfect multiple family vacation.When you enter through the front door you are greeted with an open living, dining and kitchen space with a light and airy feel. The farm style dining room table is a great spot for a good meal and some board games. The door off the kitchen will take you to the carriage house.The first floor is home to a bedroom with a queen bed and en suite bathroom that has a stand-up shower.Upon arrival on the second floor, there are 3 bedrooms and a laundry room. First room on the right is a queen bedroom with an en suite bath including a tub/shower combination.Master bedroom is home to a king bed, large master bath with a separate tub, stand up shower and double vanity. This room has a door to a private porch.The bunk room features a twin/twin bunk and is the perfect cozy spot for kiddos to play games or read books.Loft/kids hang out area has F-U-N fun written all over it, with its happy decor.Need some privacy? Call dibs on the carriage house! Amazing space with a private bedroom that has a queen-sized bed, full ensuite bath with stand-up shower. This carriage house is fully equipped with a full-sized kitchen and living room. The bedroom is private and comfortable! The carriage house also includes its own washer and dryer. The carriage house is a cozy hideaway on its own!Hello Sunshine can't wait to have you!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):First floor - Guest bedroom: Queen sized bed, en suite bath with stand-up showerSecond floor - Guest bedroom: Queen sized bed, en suite bath with tub/shower comboSecond floor - Master bedroom: King sized bed, en suite bath with separate tub, shower and double vanitySecond floor - Bunk Room: Twin over twin bunk bedCarriage House: queen sized bed, en suite bath with stand-up shower, pull out sleeper sofaAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​Show less
